description: This file contains a unit test class `LDAPSyncServiceTest` for testing LDAP synchronization functionality within the OrangeHRM system. It includes setup for LDAP server configuration, multiple test methods to verify fetching LDAP entries, handling special characters, and creating system users with LDAP data.

classes.name: LDAPSyncServiceTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for validating the LDAP synchronization service in the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: setUpBeforeClass
methods.description: Initial setup before any tests run, checks LDAP server configuration.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares test environment before each test, including data loading.

methods.name: configureServerAndLoadData
methods.description: Configures LDAP server settings and loads test LDAP data.

methods.name: testFetchEntryCollections
methods.description: Tests fetching LDAP entry collections with specific search settings.

methods.name: testFetchEntryCollectionsWithOneLevelLookupEmptyBase
methods.description: Tests LDAP fetching with a one-level lookup and empty base DN.

methods.name: testFetchEntryCollectionsWithOneLevelLookup
methods.description: Tests LDAP fetching with a one-level lookup on a specific base DN.

methods.name: testFetchEntryCollectionsWithMultipleLookups
methods.description: Tests LDAP fetching with multiple lookup configurations.

methods.name: testFetchEntryCollectionsBindAnon
methods.description: Tests fetching LDAP entries with anonymous binding.

methods.name: testFetchAllLDAPUsers
methods.description: Tests fetching all LDAP users, including serialization of the collection.

methods.name: testFetchAllLDAPUsersWithSpecialCharacters
methods.description: Tests LDAP fetching with user entries containing special characters and verifies encoding.

methods.name: testCreateSystemUsers
methods.description: Tests creating system users from LDAP data and verifies entity count updates.
